# doctest

Vendored single-header C++ testing framework, used only by the engine tests.

- Upstream: https://github.com/doctest/doctest
- Version: `2.4.11`
- File: `doctest.h`
- SHA-256: `44faa038e9c3f9728efbda143748d01124ea0a27f4bf78f35a15d8fab2e039fb`
- License: MIT — see the header for the full text.

`DOCTEST_CONFIG_IMPLEMENT_WITH_MAIN` is defined in exactly one test translation
unit per test executable.

To update: replace `doctest.h`, update the version and SHA-256 above.
